# hestiacp Provider

Terraform provider for HestiaCP — manage users, web domains, DNS, databases, email, SSL and backups via the HestiaCP REST API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) HestiaCP access key in `ACCESS_KEY:SECRET_KEY` format. May also be set via the `HESTIACP_ACCESS_KEY` environment variable.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the HestiaCP server including port, e.g. `https://myserver.com:8083`. May also be set via the `HESTIACP_URL` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Default HestiaCP username for resource operations. May also be set via the `HESTIACP_USERNAME` environment variable.
